scope: Coordinate-grid bug fix and selected CPU evidence. No training, loss, weights, physical module math or precision changes. Fresh different-budget noDINO24k and DINO8k states are separate geometry tests, not a matched DINO comparison. Two photo PSNRs fall slightly after alignment; no restoration-quality promotion or SOTA claim. Remaining finite-context errors are not solved. No CUDA/full102MP corrected-grid timing is measured. Active training/review/compilation use immutable pre-fix source and retain their original geometry; their results need that label. Working V43 geometry remains unchanged.
